stem: Which of the following planets has rings around it –
expl: Saturn is especially famous for its peculiar feature of rings. A Total of seven rings of Saturn have been discovered. Its A,B, D and E rings can be seen from Earth. The colour of Saturn from Earth seems yellow. Besides Saturn, Jupiter, Uranus and Neptune also have rings.

stem: After seven years of its journey spacecraft Cassini started its revolution in June-2004 around which planet–
expl: On October 15, 1997 the Cassini spacecraft was launched to Saturn and began its revolution around this planet in June 2004.

stem: Titan is the largest moon of the planet –
expl: Titan is the largest moon (natural satellite) of Saturn. The diameter of Titan is 5,150 km. Prominent satellite of Saturn is Atlas, Epimetheus, Tethys, Lapetus, Dione, Phoebe, Helene and Enceladus, etc. Rhea is, second largest natural satellite of Saturn, having the diameter of about 1,528 km.

stem:
Which of the following statements are correct regarding the solar system?
1. Mercury is the hottest planet in the solar system.
2. Ganymede, satellite of Saturn, is the largest satellite in the solar system.
3. Neptune is surrounded by methane gas rings of sub-zero temperature.
4. Phobos and Deimos are two satellites of Mars
expl: The hottest planet in the Solar System is Venus. Its mean temperature is 4640C. Jupiter's satellite Ganymede is the largest Satellite in the Solar System. Phobos and Deimos are the two satellites of Mars. Neptune is surrounded by rings of methane gas at subzero temperatures. Due to this, the colour of Neptune appears to be blue-green.

stem: The coldest planet in the solar system is –
expl: Neptune which is farthest from the Sun, is the coldest planet of our solar system. The temperature of Neptune's surface is –200º C and its atmosphere is made up of hydrogen, helium and methane.

stem: Which of the following planets is the farthest planet of the solar system –

options.label: c
options.text: Some times Neptune and some times Pluto

expl: Generally, Pluto is considered the farthest planet from the Sun. As its orbit lies inside the orbit of Neptune, sometimes Neptune becomes the farthest planet from the Sun. Neptune was farthest from 1979 to 1999 but from 11th February, 1999. Pluto will be the farthest planet for the next 228 years. Hence, it can be seen that sometimes Pluto and sometimes Neptune become the farthest planet from the Sun. As in 2006, Pluto was declared a dwarf planet, hence now Neptune is the correct answer for this question.

stem: Nix and Hydra are the moons of –
expl: Pluto is a dwarf planet of the Solar System, it has five satellites (moons). According to the distance from Pluto (from inner to outer side) their names are Charon, Styx, Nix, Kerberos and Hydra. Charon is the biggest satellite. There are 97 known satellites of Jupiter and till now there is no information about the existence of any satellite of Venus and Mercury.
